title: Plan step runs referrers on every symbol a bug's repro calls, so a repro that needs a shared function changed has its callers in touches before the start
goal: The kb-sprint plan step says to run referrers on each function a committed bug's repro calls or asserts on and to put each caller in touches, so a worker is not stopped for touches (BG-ui3f5s37 stopped with no fix and again at land for a doc that names scratch_dir, both for callers of scratch_dir outside its touches)

run:
import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('## start',1)[0].lower()
miss=[w for w in ['repro calls', 'referrers'] if w not in s]
sys.exit('not yet: plan section lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
